title: Music City Flat
description:
Welcome to our one-bedroom flat in the heart of Nashville. Located a 5 minute walk to Bicentennial Park and the farmers market. And only a 15-20 minute walk or 5 minute ride to Broadway. The living room is spacious with a queen pull-out couch and is open to the fully equipped kitchen. The bedroom has a King sized bed for maximum comfort and a seating area for morning coffee. Please let us know if you have any questions or don’t see the dates you want. We're happy to accommodate If possible.

The space
The one bedroom has a door that closes for privacy and has its own access to the bathroom through the large walk-in closet. Our pull-out couch has a memory foam mattress, pillows, sheets, and a comforter.

Enjoy watching your own shows by logging into Guest Access on our Roku. You can also watch Live TV for free using the Roku Channel.

If driving your own car or renting a car, we provide a free and secure parking spot designated for you in the parking garage under the building.

Guest access
The entire condo and parking spot in the garage.

There is an elevator for your use in the atrium of the building. As well as two stairwells on either end of the building leading into the parking garage.

Other things to note
Dogs are allowed at no extra cost. Please NO CATS, we are allergic. Thanks so much.
